description: Generate a PDF from a Bannerify template and return a link to the stored file. Pass layer overrides in `modifications`.

modifications.description: Layer overrides keyed by layer name. A string replaces the layer text, e.g. {"headline":"Summer sale"}. An object sets layer specific fields, e.g. {"photo":{"src":"https://example.com/a.png"}}, {"qr":{"qrcode":"https://example.com"}}, {"table":{"rows":[["A","B"]]}}, {"tag":{"visible":false}}.

templateId.description: The template id, for example tpl_abc123

name: create_pdf
title: Create PDF
